name: NO AI Self-Improvement w/ RL - YouTube
content: RLVR (Reinforcement Learning w/ Verifiable Rewards) is viewed as a pathway to self-evolving LLMs with continuously expanding reasoning capabilities, potentially advancing us closer to stronger intelligence Self-Exploration a YES with RL Reinforcement Learning (RL) Is Not Enough for AI Self-Evolution. RL training does not improve, but even downgrade, LLMs’ potential scope of reasoning capability. New Ai research critiques the ability of pure RLVR, driven solely by rewards on self-generated outputs, to induce fundamentally new reasoning beyond the base model's prior. The limitation identified is specific to the mechanism of learning only from verifiable rewards on self-exploration. Does it really induce reasoning capabilities that go beyond the pre-trained language model? Is this really possible? Because let me ask you one question. Where the hell is this reasoning capability coming from?
